stem:
Nalini’s class in Jaipur is heating water in a glass beaker on a spirit lamp. The teacher asks her to measure the temperature of the hot water, which may rise above 50 °C.

Which thermometer should she choose?

options.text: A non-contact infrared thermometer meant only for forehead checks
Any thermometer, because all thermometers measure every kind of temperature

teacher.key_rationale: Hot water in a beaker needs a laboratory thermometer with a suitable range. A clinical thermometer is for body temperature. An IR forehead device is not for beaker water. Not every thermometer fits every task.
